## Motivation

* Suppose we want to solve

$$
\frac{du}{dt} = f(u, t) + g(u, t) \\
$$

![`f+g` can be much more complicated than `f` and `g` individually](additive-split-of-fields.svg)

## Defining and solving an ODE

Let's solve the Lorenz equations

$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{dx}{dt} &= σ(y-x) \\
\frac{dy}{dt} &= x(ρ-z) - y \\
\frac{dz}{dt} &= xy - βz \\
\end{aligned}
$$
